title: Faculties
html:
• Aṅguttara Nikāya 4.151 Numbered Discourses 4.151
  • 16. Indriyavagga 16. Faculties

Indriyasutta Faculties

“Cattārimāni, bhikkhave, indriyāni. “Mendicants, there are these four faculties. Katamāni cattāri? What four? Saddhindriyaṁ, vīriyindriyaṁ, satindriyaṁ, samādhindriyaṁ—The faculties of faith, energy, mindfulness, and immersion. Imāni kho, bhikkhave, cattāri indriyānī”ti. These are the four faculties.”

Paṭhamaṁ.
